title: North Island counties and districts map, 1981
credit: Department of Lands and Survey New Zealand; National Library of New Zealand, sourced from LINZ; via Wikimedia Commons.
altText: 1981 map of North Island counties and districts with administrative boundaries and place labels.
caption: North Island counties and districts in 1981, published by the Department of Lands and Survey before the 1989 local-government reforms.
context: This administrative map predates the 1989 local-government reforms. It helps orient the reader to the county and district system before the reform; it is an historical map, not a GIS interface or a representation of the new authorities.
sourceFileTitle: File:New Zealand North Island Counties and Districts Map 1981.jpg; locally stored 1920 × 2317 rendition
derivativesNote: The locally stored JPEG is a 1920 × 2317 Wikimedia Commons rendition.
